channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyrese Maxey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyrese Maxey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
LeBron James on Tyrese Maxey:

“He is not quiet, and I am saying that in a good way. If there are things that happen on the floor, if there are things that he sees, if there are things that we see, we automatically figure it out right there on the floor. He is a very cerebral player and he is always looking for ways to get better on the floor. Even at his young age, he definitely feels like he is much older. He definitely feels like he is not in year two, and that is great to have. We have a lot of guys that have been around the block, a lot of guys that have a voice, and a lot of guys that want to get better every day and hold each other accountable, and that is great to see.”

LeBron James on Tyrese Maxey, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade on the high basketball IQ of new 76ers teammates:

“It is completely different. You know their tendencies playing against them, but when you are on the same team, you can pick their brain. My biggest thing is the way they think the game is the most impressive thing. Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, everyone, the way they think the game is at such a high level. As an NBA player, you think you know the game well, and then you get on a team like this and it is night and day. You see the way they think about plays, think about defenses, the way they think about rotations. It is similar to some things I thought, but they go a little more in-depth and it is super impressive.”

Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dean Wade on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade:

“They are unbelievable. They are so fast and quick. Tyrese Maxey, he gets out in transition and it is unbelievable how fast he moves, how fast he can change direction. I feel like the thing that really surprised me the most is they never make the wrong decision, they are always making the right decision. If that is dashing it out on the baseline, kicking out, scoring, whatever it is, they always make the right decision. That is hard, especially for a young guy. Tyrese Maxey is only in his second year, so seeing him, he is playing like he is a vet. He knows the right plays and he is doing it and he is not forcing anything.”

Dean Wade on Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Adam Aaronson:Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey:

“He’s just been a great communicator. He’s been leading with his voice early on. He's going out of his way to make sure that I feel comfortable in the system.”

Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey:

“I think Tyrese has just been a great communicator, leading with his voice early on. He's gone out of his way to make sure that I feel comfortable... Hedoesn't have to do that. I'm the type of guy that I'll figure it out regardless. But for him to try and make sure I feel welcomed, I appreciate it.”

Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dean Wade on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade on what has stood out about his new teammates:

“My biggest thing is the way they think the game is the most impressive thing. Tyrese, Joel, LeBron, JB, everyone. The way they think the game is such high level. As an NBA player, you think you know the game well and then you get on a team like this....it's night and day being on this side with them instead of against them.”

Dean Wade on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Sep 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Johnson emphasized that LeBron’s influence extends far beyond mere distribution on the stat sheet, highlighting his innate ability to unify elite talent.

“When you think about Maxey, Embiid… all those guys, now Jaylen Brown,”

Magic Johnson on Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 21, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on who was first to reach out to him when he got traded:

“Who was the first one? I’m not even sure when I found out when I first got traded, I just threw my phone across the room. Who was first? It might have been Max I think Maxey reached out to me first. He reached out and said I know it’s a lot of stuff going on right now but we excited to have you stuff like that. Maxey and V.J was probably around the same time. We talk everyday we got group chats, multiple now and we all trying to figure this thing out. LeBron is active in the group chat so we just all trying to get on the same page.”

Jaylen Brown on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Klay Thompson, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“Joel, mvp recently. Jaylen brown, recent finals mvp, Tyrese Maxey, all star the last 3 years. We all know what bron does. Klay Thompson, never a mvp candidate in nothing, 22ppg. Draymond, 14ppg 7 rebounds 6 assist, Steph a mvp just like Joel was. I don’t get how the warriors team is better on paper.”

Kevin Durant on Klay Thompson, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 4, 2026. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
VJ Edgecombe on LeBron James joining the Sixers:

“I don’t know LeBron. Like, I love LeBron, don’t get me wrong. I just never like I met him. Obviously, we played against each other. Obviously that’s who I, you know, looked up to when it comes to basketball and stuff like that. That’s one of the reasons why I started playing ball. When he was in Miami, but I ain’t know him. But I keep calling Tyrese and I was like, “Are we getting Bron? Are we getting Bron?”

VJ Edgecombe on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
While James was deciding his next destination, Edgecombe said he regularly called Maxey to ask whether the superstar was coming to Philadelphia.

“I kept calling Tyrese, and I was like, 'Are we getting Bron? Are we getting Bron?'”

VJ Edgecombe on Tyrese Maxey, Aug 4, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
“Just being a rookie and being able to be around all those guys is a privilege for me. You don’t get to see a rookie get to play with five guys that can potentially make an All-Star team [James, Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, and VJ Edgecombe]. I feel like you can learn every day, and every day you can compete against them to get better.”

Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Aug 3, 2026. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
As such, VJ Edgecombe can't wait longer to share the court with his childhood idol and play with a much more formidable Sixers squad.

“Just to learn, man. To me, he is the greatest of all time, so now we got him, [Jaylen Brown], Joe [Embiid], [Tyrese Maxey], it's a squad,”

VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 3, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Managing Partner Josh Harris said.

“I cannot wait to see LeBron alongside Jaylen Brown, VJ Edgecombe, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and our talented roster as we work to deliver a championship for Philly. To LeBron and his family: we are grateful you chose the 76ers, and look forward to this next chapter of your legendary career. Welcome to the 76ers!”

Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 27, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jared McCain on Tyrese Maxey, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Jared McCain on if he has played alongside a big man who can make screening a highlight play like Isaiah Hartenstein:

“It’s crazy. When I was in Philly, Joel would do that with Tyrese and I was like ‘Dang, that’s really cool right there.’ So being able to be a part of it is really fun. Playing with Hart, J-Will and Chet, they’re all elite bigs. I’m excited to play with them.”

Jared McCain on Tyrese Maxey, Isaiah Hartenstein, Mar 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“You gotta figure out where you get your spots, where you get your touches, but I think he’s done a very good job of playing with that balance of understanding like how good Tyrese Maxey is and how he can play next to him and find his spots to get his as well, but he definitely has a bright future, and he’s gonna be a tough challenge and a tough matchup for a long time.”

JB Bickerstaff on Tyrese Maxey, Mar 13, 2026. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Kyle Lowry on Tyrese Maxey:

“From last year he told me Kyle don't worry about it. We won't miss the playoffs and I got you in your last season or whatever it is you will be in the playoffs no matter what. So I was like alright you got it”

Kyle Lowry on Tyrese Maxey, Feb 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Paul George on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Paul George with a professional answer on his role.

“Joel, Tyrese are our two engines. Those guys are going to, rightfully so, demand attention. Demand the ball in moments to score and I gotta fit in... More than anything, defensively I know I can still be elite.”

Paul George on Tyrese Maxey, Jan 8, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Rich Paul on Jayson Tatum, Darius Garland, Tyrese Maxey, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Rich Paul:

“So no, I don't represent Cade Cunningham — but I do represent Cade Cunningham, right? I don’t represent someone else — I represent Tyrese Maxey. I represent Darius Garland. I represent De’Aaron Fox. I represent — you know, the list goes on and on and on — as their actual agent. But when you talk about other people — the Ja Morants, the Jayson Tatums, and these guys — I don't technically represent those guys. But what I do matters for those guys, even without representing them.”

Rich Paul on Jayson Tatum, Darius Garland, Tyrese Maxey, Cade Cunningham, Dec 6, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Derek Bodner:VJ Edgecombe, on Tyrese Maxey's 40 point performance:

“When it started, I was watching from the bench. I'm like, I just realized how good he is. He's really good. It helped me. I wasn't expecting to have super wide open shots like that. He requires so much attention.”

VJ Edgecombe on Tyrese Maxey, Oct 24, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Maxey, Tyrese Haliburton, Jaden McDaniels
item.description:
Anthony Edwards:

“Me at one. I would go LaMelo at two. I'm going Tyrese Maxey at three. Tyrese Haliburton at four. I'm going Jayden, Jaden McDaniels... Nah, I'm going Jayden for sure.”

Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Maxey, Tyrese Haliburton, Jaden McDaniels, Apr 30, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey, Jared McCain
item.description:
Nick Nurse on the Clippers’ defense vs Tyrese Maxey and Jared McCain:

“They sent a lot of people at ‘em. They had the lane plugged pretty good, kinda random. They were playing a 2-on-2, switching a lot and then just kinda had a rover in the middle, almost like a spy…”

Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey, Jared McCain, Nov 25, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: James Harden on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
ClutchPoints:James Harden:

“I got the pleasure & opportunity to be with Tyrese [Maxey] 2 years ago. He work his a*s off. What did you just sign for?”

James Harden on Tyrese Maxey, Aug 13, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ricky Council on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“All he was giving me was advice and helping me. ‘When we’re at halftime, be the first one out.’ There’s a lot of things. I can’t even put everything into words, but he’s helped me a lot. He gets a lot of hate and I don’t know where it comes from. He’s a really good person. And obviously Tyrese (Maxey). He’s helped a lot, too. He’s more around my age, so it’s kind of like a big brother and a middle-aged brother. Yeah, them two for sure.”

Ricky Council on Tyrese Maxey, May 9, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“That’s what they get paid for. Our job is to get better as basketball players. Every single year, I find a way to get better. Tyrese has gotten so much better, and I think there’s even another step that he can take. Some of the guys in the locker room, they’ve gotten better. Every single year, I’ve gotten better, so I’m excited to keep working on my game and myself, keep getting better, but when it comes to guys around, I like our group of guys.”

Joel Embiid on Tyrese Maxey, May 6, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“We’re just going to keep making the right plays, you know, trust my guys to knock down those shots. And they’re in the gaps more, they’re really trying to pressure me so that’s where I try to use myself as a decoy. …Tyrese is going to come and make a wide-open layup or shoot it or be able to drive.”

Joel Embiid on Tyrese Maxey, May 2, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jon Stewart on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
one fan wrote on X.Comedian and television host Jon Stewart poked fun at himself when his perplexed reaction to the Maxey show became a meme.

“Respect to Maxey…but damn…I’m clearly getting too old for this s–t,”

Jon Stewart on Tyrese Maxey, May 1, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Kyle Lowry, Robert Covington, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“I think the next game will be finally the one. We will have Tyrese [Maxey] and KL [Kyle Lowry] back. We got Joel. We just miss RoCo [Robert Covington].… I think we are more focused on [players returning]. We are focused on how we can be the best team past [Sunday].”

Nicolas Batum on Kyle Lowry, Robert Covington, Tyrese Maxey, Apr 11, 2024. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey (42 pts, 4 reb, 4 ast) tonight vs. Houston:

“I thought he was really great with his jets on tonight. I just love it when he takes off and tries to make a play. He took hits and bumps… I loved his aggressiveness tonight.”

Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey, Dec 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.
